info.sub_ename: CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS FOR ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING TECHNOLOGIES

description.sub_ename: CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS FOR ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING TECHNOLOGIES
description.describe_ch: 講授3D列印技術基礎原理與高分子、金屬及複合材料列印製造流程。讓學生學習如何從虛擬設計概念到產品生命週期結束的過程中，適時適地的拓展3D列印技術價值；課程中也會讓學生獲得設計3D列印工件所需技能，並結合工程上計算導向設計與了解3D列印技術特定製造流程的拘束；進而評估商業案例在實際半導入或全導入3D列印製程後，能優於傳統製成的轉型模式。
description.describe_eh: The course covers the fundamental principles and workflow for AM of polymers, metals, and composites. Students will acquire the skills necessary to design AM parts that combine engineering knowledge with computationally-driven design and process-specific constraints, and evaluate a product to be made using AM versus the conventional approach.

textBooks.tpb_book: Additive Manufacturing Technologies: Rapid Prototyping to Direct Digital Manufacturing. The book covers various aspects of joining materials to form parts. Additive Manufacturing (AM) is an automated technique for direct conversion of 3D CAD data into physical objects using a variety of approaches.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
2. All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
3. Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. 
4. You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
5. Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
6. Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
7. Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.

courseBankC.describe_en: To learn about additive manufacturing knowledge
courseBankC.core_item: 應用基礎科學以系統化思維發掘、研判及診斷機械工程問題之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability to solve mechanical engineering problems with basic sciences and systematic thinking.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 能熟悉3D列印技術製造與實務
courseBankC.describe_en: To be familiar with additive manufacturing technology and practice
courseBankC.core_item: 具備應用電腦輔助模式來描述及分析機械工程相關問題，以解決複雜且整合性工程問題之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability to describe and analyze mechanical engineering-related problems by applying computer-aided models in order to solve complex and integrated engineering problems.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 能熟悉3D列印製造技術設備設計與應用
courseBankC.describe_en: To be familiar with additive manufacturing equipment technology and its applications
courseBankC.core_item: 具備機械工程領域相關分析及應用軟體之能力與機械專業領域自我學習及持續發展之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability to analyze problem, apply relevant software, self-learning and develop continuously in mechanical engineering.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 能分析3D列印導入製成之評估
courseBankC.describe_en: To evaluate the feasibility for transitioning additive manufacturing in part or in whole
courseBankC.core_item: 具備蒐集資料、規範問題、並加以分析驗證獲得初步結論之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Ability to collect data, standardize and analyze problem in order to obtain preliminary conclusions.
